file_insights.changes: Added new [project.optional-dependencies] section with dev group containing three linting/type-checking tools

technical_details.version_constraints: All pinned with lower bound and upper bound constraints to prevent major version changes

patterns_discovered.description: Tools separated into optional-dependencies section rather than main dependencies, allowing conditional installation
patterns_discovered.significance: Follows Python packaging best practices by distinguishing dev/code-quality tools from runtime dependencies

patterns_discovered.description: All packages use format 'package>=X.Y.Z,<X+1.0.0' to allow patch updates while preventing breaking changes
patterns_discovered.significance: Ensures reproducible builds while staying updated on bug fixes

patterns_discovered.description: Three complementary tools added: ruff (linting/formatting), mypy (type checking), bandit (security analysis)
patterns_discovered.significance: Comprehensive static analysis coverage across style, types, and security

gotchas_discovered.description: New section placed after main dependencies but before [tool.poetry], following logical grouping
gotchas_discovered.impact: Correct structure for pyproject.toml but developers must know to install with 'pip install .[dev]' rather than just base install

approach_outcome.changes_applied: Added optional dev dependencies section with three code quality tools (ruff, mypy, bandit) with appropriate version constraints
approach_outcome.session_efficiency: Completed in single successful attempt with no revisions needed

recommendations.recommendation: Add instructions for installing dev dependencies to project README
recommendations.rationale: Users need to know to run 'pip install -e .[dev]' to get linting tools

recommendations.recommendation: Consider adding corresponding [tool.ruff], [tool.mypy], and [tool.bandit] configuration sections
recommendations.rationale: Ensures consistent tool behavior across development environments

recommendations.recommendation: Set up pre-commit hooks or CI pipeline to run these three tools automatically
recommendations.rationale: Tools are only useful if consistently applied during development workflow
